title: Post-IMS Autofluorescence Microscopy
author: Heath Patterson
materials: Select appropriate scan profile template (e.g. HuBMAP-postAF_10x-LED.czspf)
If desired, images can be exported via Zen software under the Processing tab using the Image Export method in formats including Tiff, PNG, and JPEG.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Slide
steps.instruction: Place the microscope slide into the adapter and insert it into the Zeiss AxioScan Z1 Slide Scanner.

substeps.instruction: Orient the slide with the label facing downward in the adapter.
Match the orientation of the slides within the Zeiss adapter and the Bruker two-slide holder for IMS registration.

steps.title: Configure File Management
steps.instruction: Set up the data storage and identification for the scan.

substeps.instruction: Change the file storage location to the appropriate local folder.
Name each slide with the date, donor, and modality information.

steps.title: Define Imaging Region
steps.instruction: Perform a preview scan of each slide and define the tissue imaging region using the Tissue Detection Wizard.

substeps.instruction: Access the Tissue Detection Wizard via the gear icon on the right of the Scan Profile selection for each slide.
Outline the imaging region area using the polygon, square, circle, or spline tool.

steps.title: Perform Coarse Focusing
steps.instruction: Execute coarse focusing of the tissue using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Reference Channel: EGFP filter set (peak emission 509 nm)
Exposure time: ~30 ms
LED light source: ~50-90%
Software autofocus: Default quality, Full search
Sampling: Coarse sampling Z-positions from 3700um to 4300um using ~14.24 µm step size
Support points: ~8

steps.title: Perform Fine Focusing
steps.instruction: Execute fine focusing of the tissue using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Reference Channel: EGFP filter set (peak emission 509 nm)
Exposure time: ~30 ms
LED light source: ~50-90%
Software autofocus: Default quality, Full search
Sampling: Medium sampling Z-range of 30um using ~7.12 µm step size
Support points: ~8

steps.title: Acquire Images
steps.instruction: Press 'Start Scan' to begin image acquisition of tiled brightfield and autofluorescence images.

substeps.instruction: EGFP channel (focus reference): ex. 450-490 nm; em. 500-550, green; ~50-90% LED light source; ~90 ms exposure time
Brightfield channel (transmitted light): ~0.2% Transmitted light (TL) lamp intensity; ~1.004 ms exposure time

steps.title: Visualize Results
steps.instruction: Visualize the resulting .czi files using Zen or QuPath software.
